notes: Stories refined for clearer separation of schema, core logic, enforcement API, integration, and testing. No new IDs created per feature lock.

change_log.value: Clarified schema to include routing rules (read/write separation), environment isolation, and validation constraints for cluster selection.
Expanded logic to include deterministic routing resolution and explicit prevention of cross-cluster data access.
Clarified governed access pattern as factory/get_client interface with strict enforcement and rejection of bypass paths.
Expanded integration scope to explicitly include all Mongo consumers (facades, pipelines, logging) and removal of legacy direct connections.
Expanded tests to include failure scenarios (cluster outage), misrouting attempts, and environment isolation validation.

stories.title: Cluster Routing Configuration Schema
stories.description: Define configuration schema for multi-cluster MongoDB routing including cluster identifiers, environment mapping (dev/qa/prod), read/write separation, routing rules, and strict validation constraints to ensure deterministic cluster selection.

stories.title: Core Cluster Routing Logic
stories.description: Implement backend routing logic that deterministically resolves the correct MongoDB cluster based on operation type, environment, and service context, with explicit safeguards preventing cross-cluster data access.

stories.title: Connection Governance Enforcement and Internal API Interface
stories.description: Implement a governed connection access layer enforcing that all MongoDB interactions use a controlled factory/get_client interface, rejecting direct connections and validating routing decisions at runtime.

stories.title: Integration with Existing Services
stories.description: Refactor all MongoDB consumers (provider search, embeddings, debug logger, pipelines, and facades) to use governed connection APIs, removing any direct or legacy connection paths.

stories.title: Routing Validation and Integration Tests
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests validating correct routing, enforcement of governance rules, prevention of cross-cluster access, environment isolation, and resilience under cluster failure scenarios.
